slides.title: An empty record has several explanations
slides.premise: A missing account does not, by itself, show why it is missing.
slides.question:
How do contributors decide
what to leave unrecorded?
slides.notes: Open research question; no observed participant accounts.

slides.title: Distinguish possible explanations

rows: A contributor chose not to record it

slides.notes: Sensitising concepts for a planned study, not established categories derived from data.

slides.title: A qualitative study is planned
blocks: Invite archive contributors to discuss a decision they are willing to share.
Compare their explanations with the relevant collection policies.
Develop interpretations collaboratively and retain disagreements.
slides.notes: Recruitment, consent and analysis have not occurred. No device, application or quantitative outcome is required.

slides.title: Separate permission to discuss and to publish

conditions.title: Research conversation
conditions.text:
Participants choose which decisions to discuss.

They may decline a topic.

conditions.title: Publication decision
conditions.text:
Seek separate permission for any quoted account.

Retain anonymity preferences.

slides.notes: Proposed procedures; local review and participant agreement remain necessary.

slides.title: Study the decision behind an absent account
takeaways: Question: what makes contributors leave an account unrecorded?
Method: planned interviews and policy comparison.
Limit: no findings exist yet; the concepts may change.
slides.notes: Fictional author/contact. No empirical participant data or citations to real studies.
